about: EVERY sender that can post to ntfy.sh from the home IP, declared once. ntfy.sh counts 250
messages per UTC day per SOURCE IP, so a sender missing from this list is spending a budget
nobody can see. ntfy-policy.json says HOW MUCH may be spent; this file says WHO spends it.
route: library = calls a policy reader before each push; direct = posts itself; am-webhook =
Alertmanager's own webhook; gatus = Gatus's ntfy alert provider; ci = a CI job step.
mode: gated = reads the policy and decides before every push, and writes the send ledger;
counted = does not read the policy first, but every accepted push lands in the ledger after the
fact (counted_by says where); exempt = declared not to need either, with the reason;
uncounted = KNOWN to spend the quota with nothing counting it -- allowed only with `owed`.
Every name in the policy's cap/reserve exemptions must be a publisher declared here.
COMPLETENESS IS NOT CHECKED YET: this list was built by hand from a read of every repo's
origin/main (2026-10-24). An estate send-point scan that fails on a send point no entry
declares is OWED (plans estate-roadmap M1); until it exists, a new sender can be missing here.

senders.name: edge-host-lib-notify
senders.why: the bash library every edge-host script sources; flush/drain/digest replay its spools under the same budget.

senders.name: edge-host-notify-fallback
senders.why: the LOUD fallback for a script whose lib-notify.sh would not source: the policy reader is exactly what failed. p1/p2 only, per-(script,title) cooldown 900s/3600s, stamps fallback/<script> that edge-sweep's notify-fallback check reads (edge-host#508).

senders.name: trade-data-ntfy-client
senders.why: the one push path in the service containers (service/platform/notify.py notify(Notice) -> Delivery); writes the shared ledger through the bind-mounted state dir.

senders.name: trade-data-windmill-error-handler
senders.why: a Windmill script runs alone and cannot read the policy file, so it carries the cap/reserve as literals; trade-data tests/test_ntfy_policy.py pins those literals to the policy at both boundaries.

senders.name: llmbox-lib-notify
senders.why: the llm box's PowerShell reader; no night flush there, so a night p2 pushes (policy night.note).

senders.name: llmbox-raw-fallbacks
senders.why: raw Invoke-RestMethod posts used ONLY when lib-notify.ps1 is absent: the library-absent fallback, decided 2026-10-24 (a lost page is worse than a noisy one).

senders.name: alertmanager
senders.counted_by: edge-host scripts/am-heartbeat-watch.sh am_ledger_sync: webhook notifications_total - failed_total, appended to the ledger as publisher alertmanager
senders.why: Alertmanager POSTs to ntfy.sh by webhook and reads no policy. Its night mute is a hand copy of policy.night; `edge-notify am-night` (this package) is the check, and pinning it in trade-infra CI is OWED (round 6 gap 3, lands after this release).

senders.name: observer-alertmanager
where: observer VM: prom/alertmanager running trade-infra's infra/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml
senders.why: the observer's Alertmanager renders every receiver URL to http://ntfy:80 (the observer's own ntfy, no upstream-base-url), measured 2026-10-24, so it spends no ntfy.sh quota. Re-judge at the observer cutover (trade-infra#673).

senders.name: grafana-contact-points
senders.owed: contact points ntfy-wake (NTFY_TOPIC_P1) and ntfy-heads-up (NTFY_TOPIC) are webhooks to $NTFY_BASE_URL, compose default https://ntfy.sh (docker-compose.yml grafana env), from edge-host = the home IP. No policy read, no ledger line: they land in edge_ntfy_sent_unattributed. Close = count them (Grafana's notification metrics -> ledger, like am_ledger_sync) or route them through Alertmanager.
senders.why: Grafana-native alert rules (page=heads-up, box-down) deliver through Grafana's own contact points.

senders.name: trade-infra-deploy-bluegreen
senders.owed: ntfy_push() is a raw curl to NTFY_BASE_URL (default https://ntfy.sh) on the box: emergency RTH deploy, auth refused, canary failures and a scorecard on EVERY deploy. No policy, no ledger. Close = source edge-host lib-notify.sh (gated) like every other box script.
senders.why: the blue/green deploy script reports its own outcome to the phone.

senders.name: gatus
senders.owed: the `self` group and the duplicate public `edge-host ping` alert post to PUBLIC ntfy.sh from the observer VM, whose egress IS the home IP (measured 2026-10-24). They land in edge_ntfy_sent_unattributed. Closing this = count them (mode counted) -- round 6 gap 4.
senders.why: the off-box observer must page when edge-host itself is down, so it cannot depend on edge-host's library.

senders.name: ci-github-hosted
senders.why: every CI ntfy push step runs on a GitHub-HOSTED runner (runs-on: ubuntu-latest; runner_name 'GitHub Actions 10000xxxxx' measured 2026-10-24), whose egress is not the home IP, so it cannot spend the per-IP quota. A push step on a self-hosted (vars.CI_RUNNER) job would.
